description: Felipe Dog trainer offers canine training programs and in-home lessons across Rio de Janeiro. Services include basic and advanced obedience, puppy education, and behaviour modification for issues like excessive barking, pulling on leash and separation anxiety. The center also provides an intensive boarding program with structured socialization at CT Patas ao Vento.
